description: Browse a country's national documents by title/type, newest-first by document date. documentKind ("act" | "decision") tells legislation from case law. Cost: 3 credits per call. Paging: page reaches only the first 1,000 rows; cursor (the previous nextCursor, without page) reaches any depth.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's nextCursor — pages past the first 1,000 rows. Not combined with page.

documentType.description: Document type as stored for this country.

jurisdiction.description: Two-letter code of a live country, e.g. "at" (lex_national_coverage lists them).

page.description: 1-based page, first 1,000 rows only. Omit when paging with cursor.

name: lex_list_national_documents
title: Browse national documents
